assistantMessage.text:
Here is what the repository uses for live browser updates.

## Mechanism: **Server-Sent Events (SSE)**

There is **no WebSocket** implementation. Live updates use **SSE** over HTTP:

- **Hub / broadcaster:** `SSEHub` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`
- **HTTP endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/sse` in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`
- **Helpers:** `server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go` (`resolveSSECreatorID`, `buildMemoReactionSSEEvent`, etc.)
- **Client:** `web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts` connects via `fetch("/api/v1/sse", ...)`

### How it works

`SSEHub` keeps subscribed `SSEClient` connections and fans out events with `Broadcast()`. Each client has a buffered channel; slow clients drop events instead of blocking the broadcaster. Delivery is filtered by memo visibility and creator (`canReceive` in `sse_hub.go`).

The hub is created on `APIV1Service` in `v1.go` and wired into the server in `server/server.go`.

---

## Hub implementation file

**`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`**

Defines `SSEHub`, `SSEClient`, `SSEEvent`, event types (`memo.created`, `memo.updated`, etc.), and `Broadcast()`.

---

## Memo handlers that broadcast through the hub

| Handler | Event type | File |
|---------|------------|------|
| **`CreateMemo`** | `memo.created` | `memo_service.go` |
| **`UpdateMemo`** | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `memo_service.go` |
| **`DeleteMemo`** | `memo.deleted` | `memo_service.go` |
| **`CreateMemoComment`** | `memo.comment.created` | `memo_service_comments.go` |
| **`SetMemoAttachments`** | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `memo_attachment_service.go` |
| **`SetMemoRelations`** | `memo.updated` (via `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`) | `memo_relation_service.go` |
| **`UpsertMemoReaction`** | `reaction.upserted` | `reaction_service.go` |
| **`DeleteMemoReaction`** | `reaction.deleted` | `reaction_service.go` |

`memo.updated` broadcasts are centralized in **`dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects`** in `memo_update_helpers.go`, called from `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, and `SetMemoRelations`.

`CreateMemo` skips SSE when called from `CreateMemoComment` (via `isSSESuppressed(ctx)`), so comment creation only emits `memo.comment.created`, not a duplicate `memo.created`.

---

## Related files

- `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` — SSE route registration and connection handling
- `server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go` — SSE event construction helpers
- `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub_test.go`, `sse_handler_test.go`, `sse_service_test.go` — tests
- `web/src/hooks/useLiveMemoRefresh.ts` — browser consumer
